description.text: TeachingObjectives The BEcon programme trains students in economic theory, statistical tools, the application of theory to solve practical economic problems in trade, banking, the labour market, and evaluate the regional economic performances of China, Hong Kong and other economies. Students will be furnished with solid theoretical and empirical economic knowledge to analyse and understand human behaviour and social interactions. The programme allows students a high degree of flexibility in planning their future career specialisation. Students may also declare a minor or a second major if they are able to meet the respective requirements. Main Courses Compulsory major: Economics Optional majors: Business Design and Innovation Human Resource Management Quantitative Finance Information Systems Marketing Wealth Management Duration 4 years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Economicsby The University of Hong Kong Future Career Given the solid training, graduates of the BEcon programmes are equipped to excel in a wide variety of jobs. Most graduates have secured employment in banks, financial institutions and major corporations. Some have developed careers in government and education, while others have furthered their studies in universities locally and overseas.

duration.text: The Bachelor of Economics at The University of Hong Kong is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 15736 USD/per year ￥ 113305 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. a photocopy of your passport / National identity card / birth certificate 2. referee's report (Word format, PDF format) / reference letter, to be completed by your school principal or teacher, or by an academic referee (In the case the referee report / reference letter is given to you by your school in a sealed envelope, please forward the report / letter to the University). For reference letter, please arrange it to be sent with a cover page which specifies the admissions scheme you applied, your full name, application number, date of birth and first choice of curriculum. 3. the predicted grade / point issued by the school 4. final/latest academic transcript(s) / examination results 5. public examination results in detail e.g. GCSE, HKCEE, HKALE, including in the case of GCE AL / AS level, the Statement of Results which shows the numerical scores achieved (optional) a summary of not more than two A4-size pages of your extra-curricular activities / personal achievements / working experience / any other information which you feel will help the selection committee in considering your application

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be under the age of 25. 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese in good health. 3. Applicants must have high school certificate or will high school certificate by September 2015. 4. Candidates with IELTS overall score of 6.5 or above with sub-score of 6.0 or above ; or overall score of 93 or above at Internet-based TOEFL with sub-score of 22 or above will be considered with preference Grade C or better in English Language at GCSE / GCEO Grade C or better in English First Language at IGCSE Grade B or better in English Second Language at IGCSE An overall band of 6.5 or better in Academic IELTS
